notes.title: DevLog: News - 25.07.16
notes.content: [p]There is a new female character Remora, kitchen location backgrounds (night and day variant) and daytime theme music.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/23ac2e4c97fcaa80e660f25fa8e7a51a374683a0.png"][/img][/p][p]All full-length characters have been drawn; they will be placed in locations and made available for interaction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/3029e1ef4c1805349c29d0691130914400cc26b6.png"][/img][/p][p]What do you think this object will be associated with?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/6130bacd40f250d2360d3519d9394d8a667fd5f2.png"][/img][/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist on Steam![/p]

notes.title: DevLog: New Location - Kithcen
notes.content: [p]Say hello to a new location in Dr. Kinderwood’s Asylum — the Kitchen, Remora’s cozy little kingdom. She cooks, sews, does the laundry… and tries not to think about the Flower Plague lurking beyond the walls.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/bb5d5e9ba9c5855cf3c49119d85922c9a4cdd722.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/cf4e1a7d36cb4f39b5d9f551f7135b88599b9fe8.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: DevLog: New Character!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/b692ea6a7acd93c617e5cac2f1fff3b684450d31.png"][/img][/p][p]Work continues on Dr. Kinderwood’s Asylum, and today we introduce you to a new character, Remora.[/p][p]She is a simple country girl with a kind heart, freckles, and a braid. Wears a dress that she hemmed herself out of the doctor’s old clothes.[/p][p]She is sweet, naive, loyal to the doctor, and afraid of catching the flower disease. She cooks, takes care of plants, and dreams of a soulmate. Remora can become the main character’s romantic interest if the player wishes.[/p][p]Remora is one of those characters whose outward simplicity hides much more. She knows a lot… but she doesn’t say everything.[/p]

notes.title: DevLog: Concept of new female character!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/568507eb533e10ba6134a3205b5c588be257ae02.png"][/img][/p][p]🛠️ Progress update: new female character for Dr. Kinderwood’s Asylum.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s an early concept. Any guesses what her role might be? 👀[/p]

notes.title: DevLog: News - 25.06.16
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="_AJif4MZQfs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Continuing to fill the Infirmary with life. Today, we’re sharing a couple of fresh changes we’re working on right now:[/p][p]👥 Life inside the walls During daylight hours, you can meet the inhabitants of the Infirmary and exchange a couple of phrases. These dialogs will help you learn more about what’s happening on behalf of each character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/72c1eab0391e4dcabb5d5c576cb7cb87bf15d189.png"][/img][/p][p]🖱 Hover tooltips. Now, a short text hint will appear if you hover over an interactive object. You know - it’s better to be attentive to details.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/71caf55d83c945be0b05b78e2bb51e51f7add0ea.png"][/img][/p][p]💬 Main character’s thought: Right-click on an interesting object to hear what the main character thinks about it. These aren’t just lines - sometimes important hints are hiding in them.[/p][p]Thank you for waiting and following the project![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503996/bbcea5968546f46565b7c5fb1095712c68ba7ef9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dr. Kinderwood's Asylum - Demo Available!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce Dr. Kinderwood's Asylum demo!

[h2]Demo Gameplay Trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=_8RwWD9FZr4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo-1.0 features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spend the first three days in the infirmary: get to know its inhabitants or focus on finding a cure.
[*] Point-and-click movement between locations and interaction with items.
[*] Illuminate active areas for interaction.
[*] Accept the consequences of the result of your active actions with a mini-game.
[*] Character Relationships.
[*] The plot is constantly moving forward.
[*] No music (work in progress, will be added later in an update to the demo).
[/list]

[h3]Translations (demo version)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Original game language: Russian.
[*] Edited English translation.
[*] MTL translation into other languages.
[/list]
[i]You can help us improve the translation by clicking the copy text button in the game and sending a report to our Discord server.[/i]

Please leave your reviews and feedback in this chat. What did you like? What was strange or disliked? What would you like to see in the game? Share your thoughts. It will help us make the game better.
